verses.1: And it happened in the sixth year of the sixth month, on the fifth day of the month. I was sitting in my house, and the elders of Judah were sitting before me. Then a hand of God fell upon me.
verses.2: And I will see that it resembles the appearance of fire, from below upward; and from above downward, it resembles a shining light, like the light of a lamp.
verses.3: And He sent His hand, and took me by the top of my head. Then a spirit carried me between the earth and heaven. And He brought me into Jerusalem, in the sight of God, to the gate of the inner courtyard that faces east. There, the symbol of jealousy is seated.
verses.4: And there was then a glory of the God of Israel, just as I saw it in the wilderness.
verses.5: And he said to Adam, “Please, let your eyes be fixed on the future. I will also fix my eyes on the future. And behold, from the future comes the symbol of this fear at the gate of the temple.”
verses.6: And he said to Adam, “Do you see what they are doing? They are committing great evils in Israel. They are causing destruction on my holy places. But still, you will see further evils from them.”
verses.7: And he brought me to the door of the house. I saw that there was a hole in the wall.
verses.8: And Adam said to his son, “Dig in the wall.” So he dug in the wall, and there was a hole.
verses.9: And he said to me, “Go and see the horrible sufferings that they are undergoing.”
verses.10: And I come and I see that all the structures of the Temple are destroyed. All the walls of the Temple of Israel have been torn down from their positions around the entire area.
verses.11: And seventy men from the elders of Israel stood before them. Azaniah son of Shaphan also stood among them. Each man held a stick in his hand. Then the smoke of the incense rose up.
verses.12: And he said to me, “See, I saw a man from Israel who is old. He works in the darkness, in the holes of his bed. For they say that Jehovah does not see us. Jehovah has abandoned this land.”
verses.13: And he said to me, “You will still return, and you will see great sufferings that those people are causing.”
verses.14: And he brought me to the entrance of the Temple of God, which was facing north. There, I saw those women sitting there, mourning over the dead bodies.
verses.15: And he said to me, “You shall see a man again; then you will see great suffering from those people.”
verses.16: He brought me to the inner courtyard of the Temple of God. There, I saw the door to the temple of God, located between the altar and the sanctuary. There were about twenty-five men who stood there, facing the temple of God. They bowed their heads in worship, with their faces turned towards the sun.
verses.17: And he said to me, “See, I saw a son of man who is sent to the house of Judah. He will do what is evil, just as they have filled the earth with suffering. They will go back and provoke me again.”
verses.18: And I will also do it with passion, so that my eyes will not see anything evil. I will not cry out in pain, and no loud voice will be heard in my ears.
